title: A shell in the sky
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: The CMB is radiation released when the early universe became transparent. Its apparent sky pattern comes from the early universe along our past light paths, not a physical wall.

misconception: A learner may choose: Yes: it is a wall surrounding the universe
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Is the cosmic microwave background an image of a physical wall at the edge of space?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Is the cosmic microwave background an image of a physical wall at the edge of space? No: it is light from an early epoch reaching us from many directions. The CMB is radiation released when the early universe became transparent. Its apparent sky pattern comes from the early universe along our past light paths, not a physical wall.
Visual caption: An epoch, not a wall. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: Is the cosmic microwave background an image of a physical wall at the edge of space?
options: No: it is light from an early epoch reaching us from many directions
Yes: it is a wall surrounding the universe
